Slaughter Cattle:                                          445(100.0%)                 489(100.0%)                     663(100.0%)

Slaughter cattle sale today: Compared to last week. Choice steers and heifers were steady- .75 higher, Dairy steers no comparison due to low
receipts, slaughter cows were steady - 1.00 higher. Trade active. Demand good. Supply included: 100% Slaughter Cattle (41% Steers, 3% Dairy
Steers, 36% Heifers, 13% Cows, 4% Bulls, 3% Beef/Dairy Steers).
